summary: Use FCC aggregates as conservative reputation evidence
description: Activate the FCC aggregate in canonical US lookups and map only source-native unwanted-call and robocall observations into bounded reputation evidence without treating complaint count as proof, corroboration, identity, or safety.
acceptance: Canonical US lookup reads the immutable HMAC-keyed FCC projection and returns only current source-native nuisance or robocall observations with count basis, provenance, freshness, bounded confidence, and explicit unverified-complaint and spoofing limitations.

One FCC source cannot independently produce elevated_signals or official_warning, complaint count cannot substitute for source diversity, no-match never becomes safe, and unsupported categories are rejected.
Missing key, missing/stale/invalid catalogue, invalid digest/metadata, absent number, malformed input, and conflicting observations fail closed with typed source coverage.
verification: uv run pytest tests/integration/test_lookup.py tests/adapters/test_us.py -q && make check
